global_prompt: A photorealistic workplace scene set in a modern corporate office, captured in one continuous long take without any cuts. The office features an elevator entrance, a coat rack, workstations, desks, and neutral corporate interiors. Realistic body language, smooth camera movement, and consistent character identities, wardrobe, lighting, and spatial continuity throughout.
local_prompts: The elevator doors open, and a professional woman with a coat on walks out of the elevator into the office.
The woman approaches a coat rack, stops beside it, takes off her outer coat and hangs it on the coat rack.
A man wearing a navy business suit walks past the woman in the opposite direction, and the camera smoothly shifts to follow him from behind.
The man walks to his workstation, pulls out his office chair, and sits down.
The man picks up a cup of tea from his desk and takes a sip.
